results.title: Transfer: Arsenal agree deal to sign Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United
results.description: Arsenal has come to an agreement with Newcastle United regarding a transfer fee of €90 million (£77 million) for Bruno Guimaraes, as reported by sources in France. The Premier League champions previously had offers of £55 million and £70 million turned down by Newcastle for the Brazilian international.
